summary: Frontend-only testing for Lumen Event Management Platform landing page + user dashboard + admin dashboard + mobile responsive. All 3 routes load cleanly with zero console errors and zero R3F errors. Hero, Brands Marquee, 3D Experience section, Upcoming Events (4 tilt cards with non-zero countdown timers e.g. 304d/100d/118d/157d), Past Events Gallery (6 items with working lightbox), CTA, and Footer all render. UserDashboard shows correct stats (12/28/47/1.2k), activity bar chart, Aurora Tech Summit 2027 upcoming card, and Saved Events grid. AdminDashboard shows Lumen Admin sidebar, top search, '+ New Event' CTA, 4 stat cards (Total Revenue $284.5k, 12,840 tickets, 8,492 users, 4.62%), revenue area chart, Top Events list, and All Events table with rows. Mobile (390px) shows hamburger and the mobile menu toggles correctly. Overall a clean, working premium landing.

issues: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute' from Framer Motion useScroll — minor; main parent (#root or App container) is likely position: static. Recommend adding position: relative to the scroll target container to silence the warning.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add missing data-testid attributes for full test automation parity: [data-testid="user-dashboard"] root on UserDashboard, [data-testid="admin-dashboard"] root on AdminDashboard, [data-testid="admin-sidebar-{overview|events|users|revenue|uploads|settings}"] for admin sidebar nav items, [data-testid="sidebar-saved-events"], [data-testid="sidebar-my-tickets"], [data-testid="sidebar-sign-out"] on user dashboard sidebar, and [data-testid="lightbox"] / [data-testid="lightbox-close"] on the past-events lightbox. Currently labels are present and visually verified, but missing testids reduce automation robustness.
(Optional/minor) Fix Framer Motion useScroll warning by giving the scroll container a non-static position (e.g., add `position: relative` to the wrapping <main>/<div> on Landing).
critical_code_review_comments: App architecture is clean: lazy-loaded routes with Suspense fallback, brand color tokens via Tailwind, components well separated.
Hero heading uses split-line layout (h1 spans multiple lines), so any test using single-string text match should use regex/substring match rather than exact match.
Lightbox does open and close correctly (visually confirmed via screenshots) — selector [data-testid="lightbox"] is just not exposed; consider adding it for testability.
No R3F runtime/overlay errors detected — CSS/SVG 3D replacement is working as intended.

Recharts area chart renders correctly on admin (visually confirmed) though it doesn't expose .recharts-wrapper at the moment my selector queried — likely rendered as plain <svg>; this is fine functionally.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this MVP
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend at https://event-flow-49.preview.emergentagent.com. Three routes: / (landing), /dashboard (user), /admin (admin). All currently working with zero console errors. Hero heading is split across 2 lines, so 'Experience Events Like Never Before' must be matched with regex/substring or two separate locators. Lightbox opens on gallery item click; close button currently doesn't have data-testid='lightbox-close' but visually works (close icon top-right). Mobile hamburger uses data-testid='navbar-mobile-toggle' and opens 'navbar-mobile-menu'. Backend was intentionally not tested per request.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — review items all pass. The only minor finding is a Framer Motion useScroll warning about non-static container position; cause is most likely the scroll target ancestor uses default static positioning. Mitigation: add `position: relative` on the wrapping container (e.g., the landing page <main> or root div) that is referenced via useScroll's container ref.
